pages.text:
top of page300 E. 24th Ave. Gulf Shores, AL251.948.BEERHomeBreweryBeer + Wine on TapPhoto GalleryLive Music + EventsThe BreweryContactLocation + HoursShopMoreUse tab to navigate through the menu items.THE TAPROOM
Big Beach Brewing company boasts a beautiful open-air taproom complete with fireplace and comfortable seating. We also have tons of table seating for those that might want to bring in or order food. A most pleasant place to unwind or even have a business meeting, Big Beach has four garage doors so the coastal breeze can flow right through our taproom.

​

You can expect to see craft beer lovers soaking up the Southern sun in our front yard. We encourage families to come visit us so that parents can have fun while kids enjoy our family friendly outside.

​

We have 12 taps at Big Beach with craft beer being our specialty. We carry Pensacola-made Big Jerk Soda for those who aren't drinkers. 

 

We are proud to offer flatbreads and shareable snacks from our Taproom Table Kitchen, open daily. We unfortunately do not permit outside food. Check our home page for kitchen hours!The Brewery
Big Beach Brewing Company is the southernmost brewery in Alabama located in the heart of Gulf Shores. We are proud of our 10 barrel brewing system that is exclusively dedicated to brewing and serving all kinds of ales from IPAs and Stouts to Cream Ales and Belgian style beers. We have six fermenters in which we are able to produce enough beers to present up to 12 beers on tap at a time. We pride ourselves on having a "tank to tap" operation. Tank to tap essentially means that instead of running our draught lines from kegs, we've got a bunch (by a bunch, we mean eight) of beautiful 300 gallon vessels behind our bar on display that tenderly hold our beer to ensure it is the freshest beer around. Our head brewer, Rod Murray, along with the owners and some of our staff are proud to be one of the first to bring local craft beer to our beloved beach town. We brew what we like, and we hope you'll like it too.The TaproomBrewery:
